Majorana 1

Microsoft · topological · CONTESTED (19 Feb 2025 (Nature parity paper; disputed in Nature Matters Arising, 24 Jun 2026)) · qubits not published · access: lab-only
architecture: טופולוגי — טטרון (מיורנה) · Open on the map

Register profile — the machine's variant of its architecture

qubit type: Majorana parity in an InAs-Al (M1) / InAs-Pb (M2) gate-defined nanowire tetron
gate mechanism: measurement-based braiding by sequences of parity measurements - nothing demonstrated; node status X
connectivity: tetron lattice (intent)
control: baseband gate voltages
control placement: baseband
readout: rf quantum-capacitance interferometric parity readout: ~1% assignment error, SNR 1 in 3.6 us; X-measurement lifetime ~1000x shorter than Z (the readout figures are not in either cited page)
flags: contested, not a qubit
